description: This file declares the interface for the IGstProtectionMetadataWrapperFactory class, which is a factory class responsible for creating instances of IGstProtectionMetadataWrapper. It includes method declarations for creating the factory and creating protection metadata wrapper objects, and references external classes such as IGstWrapper and IGstProtectionMetadataWrapper.

classes.name: IGstProtectionMetadataWrapperFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating IGstProtectionMetadataWrapper instances, providing methods to instantiate the factory and create protection metadata wrappers.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IGstProtectionMetadataWrapperFactory instance.

methods.name: createProtectionMetadataWrapper
methods.description: Creates a unique pointer to an IGstProtectionMetadataWrapper, given a shared pointer to an IGstWrapper.
